title: Nonhalting probability for the coin run
statement: For every infinite binary sequence $p$ and every natural number $K$, the probability that the procedure which reads a bit string and returns no output exactly when every bit it reads agrees with the corresponding initial bit of $p$ does not halt on a uniformly random string of $K$ bits is $(1/2)^K$.
